definitions.full: H187. Uzal אוּזָל proper name, masculine (Samaritan ᵐ5 איזל, Αἰζηλ ) 6th son of Joktan Gen 10:27 ; 1Chr 1:21 = proper name, of a location Ezek 27:19 , read ᵑ6 ᵐ5 מֵאוּזָל Hi Sm Co; old capital of Yemen, later San'â , compare Di Gen 10:27 . I. אזן ( pointed, sharp ? compare Ethiopic edge, corner, peak, pinnacle ; see also Assyrian Dl W , & אָזֵן below)
